In English, a sentence in which a named jurist looks forward to his university advising Islamic banks is one step from being read as his approving those banks, which the record nowhere says and which would matter. The hope is kept as a hope. No ruling of any kind on banking practice appears in this record.

flags.arabic: الدكتور محمد ولد سيد أوبك / الدكتور محمد سالم ولد الخو
flags.context: the department coordinator and the vice-president
options: Muhammad Ould Sid Oubek / Muhammad Salim Ould al-Khu
Mohamed Ould Sidi Oubeck / Mohamed Salem Ould El Khou
strict transliteration with diacritics
flags.note: Neither man's own Latin-script spelling is known from the record, and Mauritanian names are conventionally written in a French-based orthography that does not follow from the Arabic. The forms used are provisional. A reviewer with access to the university's own materials should settle them.

flags.context: the qualifications the department's entrants hold
options: the baccalaureate and the licence
the baccalauréat and the licence
secondary-school certificate and bachelor's degree
flags.note: Both words are borrowings from French into Mauritanian Arabic and name French-system qualifications: the baccalauréat completes secondary schooling and the licence is the first university degree. Option 3 explains them but by mapping them onto Anglophone equivalents that are not exact. The French forms are kept, since the record is describing a French-system institution.

flags.context: the field the department is to serve
options: Islamic banking
Islamic banking practice
the Islamic banking industry
flags.note: صيرفة is banking as a practice or trade, distinguished in the same paragraph from البنوك الإسلامية, the banks themselves. Both are kept distinct in the English. Not in the glossary, and it will recur wherever the corpus touches on finance.

translator_notes: A news report of an official ceremony. No ruling is stated anywhere in it and the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged. This is worth stating plainly because the record's subject is Islamic economics and a reader may come to it expecting rulings on finance: there are none here.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. Here the body's hijri and Gregorian dates agree with each other and with the timestamp.
Nothing in the record is quoted. Everything attributed to the Sheikh, to the coordinator and to the vice-president is the news desk's summary of what each said.
جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين is named in full at first mention and as Ibn Yasin University thereafter, following the source, which does the same.

The closing 'to follow the opening address click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en. The opening address itself is audio and is not in this record.

title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يحاضر في الكويت عن أثر علوم اللغة في فهم أحكام الكتاب والسنة
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures in Kuwait on the Effect of the Language Sciences on Understanding the Rulings of the Book and the Sunnah
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو أمس السبت 29 محرم 1433 الموافق: 24/12/2011 بمقر مركز "مجدد" لتكوين العلماء وحفظة القرآن بدولة الكويت محاضرة علمية، تحت عنوان: "أثر علوم اللغة في فهم أحكام الكتاب والسنة".

وفي هذه المحاضرة تناول الشيخ بالتفصيل آثار مختلف علوم اللغة (النحو، الصرف، الشعر الجاهلي، البلاغة...) في فهم الأحكام الشرعية، ودور هذه العلوم في استيعاب دلالات النصوص المتعلقة بالأحكام في الكتاب والسنة، حيث قدم الشيخ من خلال هذه المحاضرة لطلبة مركز "مجدد" لتكوين العلماء وحفظة القرآن تأصيلا لضرورة التبحر في مختلف العلوم المرتبطة باللغة العربية بوصفها الأداة التي تساعد في استيعاب النصوص الشرعية التي يعتمد عليها في استباط الأحكام حسب الوقائع والمستجدات.

تأتي هذه المحاضرة في إطار مشاركة فضيلة الشيخ الددو حفظه الله في البرنامج الذي ينظمه مركز "مجدد" لتكوين العلماء وحفظة القرآن بالكويت تحت شعار: "أيام وليالي لغتنا العربية.. لغة الدين والدنيا" وذلك خلال الزيارة التي يقوم بها لدولة الكويت للمشاركة في فعاليات ومهرجانات ومؤتمرات علمية عديدة.

لمتابعة المحاضرة اضغط هنا:
body_en:
Yesterday, Saturday 29 Muharram 1433, corresponding to 24/12/2011, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew delivered a scholarly lecture at the premises of the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an in the State of Kuwait, under the title: "The effect of the language sciences on understanding the rulings of the Book and the Sunnah".

In this lecture the Sheikh took up in detail the effects of the various language sciences (grammar (naḥw), morphology (ṣarf), pre-Islamic poetry, rhetoric (balāghah)…) on the understanding of the rulings of the Sharia, and the role of these sciences in grasping the significations of the texts bearing on rulings in the Book and the Sunnah. Through this lecture the Sheikh set out for the students of the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an a grounding in the necessity of deep mastery of the various sciences connected with the Arabic language, as the instrument that assists in grasping the texts of the Sharia relied on in deriving rulings according to the facts of cases and to newly arising matters.

This lecture comes within the participation of His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew, may God preserve him, in the programme organised by the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an in Kuwait under the banner: "Days and nights of our Arabic language — the language of religion and of the world", during the visit he is making to the State of Kuwait to take part in numerous scholarly events, festivals and conferences.

flags.arabic: في استباط الأحكام حسب الوقائع والمستجدات
flags.context: what the texts of the Sharia are relied on for
options: read as استنباط ('deriving') and translate accordingly, as done here
leave the form as it stands with no rendering
mark the word as corrupt
flags.note: استباط is not a word; the term required is استنباط, the technical uṣūl term for deriving a ruling from a text, and a nūn has dropped out. The reading is not in doubt, but the repair is in the English only: body_ar preserves the source's form, per style guide section 11.

flags.arabic: أثر علوم اللغة في فهم أحكام الكتاب والسنة
flags.context: the lecture title, and the record's only statement of its argument
options: the effect of the language sciences on understanding the rulings
the impact of the linguistic sciences on the comprehension of rulings
the bearing of Arabic philology on juristic interpretation
flags.note: This is the Sheikh's usuli argument in its compressed form and the corpus will meet it repeatedly: that the linguistic disciplines are the instrument by which the legal import of a text is established. The plainest rendering is kept. Option 3 would be more idiomatic for an academic reader but replaces علوم اللغة, a named curriculum of disciplines named in the next paragraph, with a discipline name of the translator's choosing.

flags.context: the language sciences enumerated
options: grammar (naḥw), morphology (ṣarf), pre-Islamic poetry, rhetoric (balāghah)
syntax, morphology, jāhilī poetry, rhetoric
naḥw, ṣarf, pre-Islamic poetry, balāghah
flags.note: نحو is narrower than 'grammar' and wider than 'syntax'; صرف is morphology exactly; بلاغة covers what English splits between rhetoric and stylistics. الشعر الجاهلي is 'pre-Islamic poetry' rather than a transliteration, since جاهلي as 'of the age of ignorance' would carry a judgement the term no longer makes in this usage. The house rule of plain English with the Arabic bracketed is applied, which rules out option 3.

flags.context: the host institution
options: the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an
the Mujaddid Centre for Training Scholars and Qur'an Memorisers
the Mujaddid Centre (its own English name, if it has one)
flags.note: مجدد is 'renewer', the word used of the one raised up every hundred years to renew the religion — the same idea that appears in record 759 of this span. It is kept as a name in quotation marks, as the source has it, rather than translated. تكوين العلماء is rendered 'the Formation of Scholars' to match the rendering of the Sheikh's own Centre used throughout the corpus.

translator_notes: A news report of a lecture. It describes the lecture's argument in general terms and gives no example and no ruling, so the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged. أحكام is rendered 'rulings' in its ordinary plural sense.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. The body's hijri and Gregorian dates agree with each other and with the day named.
The lecture itself exists as audio at the link recorded in source_download_link; this record is a report of it, not a text of it.
The closing 'to follow the lecture click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يُلقي محاضرات في دورة ابن قدامة بالمركز الثقافي لمؤسسة عيد الخيرية بالدوحة
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers Lectures in the Ibn Qudamah Course at the Cultural Centre of the Sheikh Eid Charitable Foundation in Doha
body_ar: انطلقت مساء أمس السبت 19 ربيع الأول 1433هـ الموافق: 2012/02/11 دورة ابن قدامة في العلوم الشرعية التي ينظمها المركز الثقافي لمؤسسة الشيخ عيد الخيرية بدولة قطر في الدوحة. ويشارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في هذه الدورة بإلقاء دروس ومحاضرات في المستوى الثاني من الدورة الذي يقام بجامع المانع بمنطقة الوعب بالدوحة، وتستمر هذه الدورة لمدة ثمانية أيام. ويشتمل برنامج الشيخ الددو على ثلاثة دروس يوميا خلال مدة الدورة؛ حيث يبدأ الدرس الأول بعد صلاة الفجر بنصف ساعة في "مصطلح الحديث"، يشرح فيه الشيخ كتاب الباعث الحثيث في شرح اختصار علوم الحديث للحافظ بن كثير. والدرس الثاني في أصول الفقه بعد صلاة العشاء بنصف ساعة، يشرح فيه كتاب التمهيد في تخريج الفروع على الأصول للأسنوي، والدرس الثالث في علوم اللغة والأدب بعد صلاة العصر يشرح فيه مقاطع من المعلقات السبع. وتلقى هذه الدورة إقبالا كبيرا من العامة والخاصة من طلبة العلم من داخل وخارج قطر، وهي دورة علمية مكثفة تُدرس فيها عدد من المتون العلمية في مختلف العلوم الشرعية ويشارك فيها نخبة من أهل الاختصاص. وسيواكب الموقع بإذن الله جديد محاضرات الشيخ في هذه الدورة ويرفعها محررة ليستفيد منها زواره الكرام.
body_en:
On the evening of yesterday, Saturday 19 Rabi' al-Awwal 1433 AH, corresponding to 11/02/2012, the Ibn Qudamah Course in the Sharia sciences began, organised by the Cultural Centre of the Sheikh Eid Charitable Foundation in the State of Qatar, in Doha. Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, is taking part in this course by giving lessons and lectures at the course's second level, which is held at the al-Mani' Mosque in the al-Waab district of Doha. The course runs for eight days.

Sheikh al-Dedew's programme comprises three lessons a day for the duration of the course. The first lesson begins half an hour after the dawn prayer (fajr) and is on the technical terminology of hadith (muṣṭalaḥ al-ḥadīth); in it the Sheikh expounds the book al-Bāʿith al-Ḥathīth fī Sharḥ Ikhtiṣār ʿUlūm al-Ḥadīth of al-Hafiz Ibn Kathir. The second lesson is in legal theory (uṣūl al-fiqh), half an hour after the night prayer (ʿishāʾ); in it he expounds the book al-Tamhīd fī Takhrīj al-Furūʿ ʿalā al-Uṣūl of al-Isnawi. The third lesson is in the language sciences and literature, after the afternoon prayer (ʿaṣr); in it he expounds passages from the Seven Suspended Odes.

The course is meeting a large turnout from the general public and from the specialists among students of knowledge, from inside Qatar and outside it. It is an intensive scholarly course in which a number of scholarly primers across the various Sharia sciences are taught and in which a select group of specialists takes part. The site will, God willing, keep pace with the Sheikh's latest lectures in this course and will upload them in edited form for the benefit of its esteemed visitors.

flags.arabic: كتاب الباعث الحثيث في شرح اختصار علوم الحديث للحافظ بن كثير
flags.context: the text expounded in the hadith-terminology lesson
options: render the attribution exactly as the source gives it, and record the difficulty
correct the attribution in the English
flags.note: APPARENT SOURCE ERROR, deliberately not fixed. Ikhtiṣār ʿUlūm al-Ḥadīth is Ibn Kathir's; al-Bāʿith al-Ḥathīth is the commentary on it by Ahmad Muhammad Shakir. The source attributes the whole title, commentary included, to Ibn Kathir. Style guide section 11 requires translating the error and flagging it rather than silently repairing it. Note also that the source writes 'بن كثير' without the alif of ابن.

flags.arabic: كتاب التمهيد في تخريج الفروع على الأصول للأسنوي
flags.context: the text expounded in the legal-theory lesson
options: al-Isnawi
al-Asnawi
flags.note: Jamal al-Din al-Isnawi (d. 772/1370), a Shafi'i usuli. Romanisation follows the style guide's rule of no diacritics on proper names in body text. The book's title is left untranslated and italic-free per the corpus convention for named works, with no English gloss supplied, since the source gives none.

flags.context: the language and literature lesson
options: passages from the Seven Suspended Odes
sections of the Muʿallaqāt
excerpts from the seven hanging poems
flags.note: al-Muʿallaqāt, the canonical pre-Islamic odes. 'Suspended Odes' is the established English. Not a religious term and not in the glossary; recorded here because the corpus will need one fixed rendering across the language-sciences section.

translator_notes: A news-desk announcement, not a text by the Sheikh. It contains no religious content of his and no rulings.
The CMS timestamp, 12 February 2012, is a bulk-upload date; the body dates the course's opening to the evening of Saturday 19 Rabi' al-Awwal 1433 / 11 February 2012.

The final sentence is the site's own undertaking to publish edited transcripts of these lectures. Whether it was kept is worth checking against the corpus: several 'Lessons' records elsewhere carry only an opening and a .doc download.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في الملتقى الدولي لرؤساء أقسام العربية في الجامعات الإفريقية بمكة
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the International Forum for Heads of Arabic Departments in African Universities, in Mecca
body_ar: يشارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين في فعاليات ملتقى علمي دولي تحتضنه مكة المكرمة، بوصفه ممثلا لجامعة ابن ياسين؛ حيث يستضيف المؤتمر رؤساء أقسام اللغة العربية في الجامعات الإفريقية. وتنظم جامعة أم القرى بمكة المكرمة هذا الملتقى الأول من نوعه، في الفترة ما بين السبت الماضي 10 ربيع الثاني 1433هـ الموافق 03 مارس 2012 إلى غاية 19 ربيع الثاني الموافق 12 مارس الجاري. وتميز هذا المتلقى العلمي بمحاضرة فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في ندوة علمية أقيمت مساء الأحد الماضي 11 ربيع الثاني الموافق: 04 مارس الجاري، وكانت تحت عنوان: "أثر الاستعمار في تغريب اللسان الإفريقي وقطعه عن منابع الثقافة الإسلامية". ونشير إلى أن الملتقى يستمر لمدة أربعة أيام يتضمن برنامجاً علمياً يشمل الجلسات العلمية والندوات وورش العمل، ثم يليه البرنامج التدريبي الذي يستمر خمسة أيام متتالية تختتم بالجلسة الختامية والتوصيات.
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University, is taking part in the proceedings of an international scholarly forum hosted by Mecca the Ennobled, in his capacity as the representative of Ibn Yasin University; the conference hosts the heads of Arabic language departments in African universities. Umm al-Qura University in Mecca the Ennobled is organising this forum, the first of its kind, in the period from last Saturday, 10 Rabi' al-Thani 1433 AH, corresponding to 3 March 2012, up to 19 Rabi' al-Thani, corresponding to 12 March of the present month.

This scholarly forum was distinguished by the lecture of Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew at a scholarly symposium held on the evening of last Sunday, 11 Rabi' al-Thani, corresponding to 4 March of the present month, under the title "The Effect of Colonialism in Westernising the African Tongue and Cutting It Off from the Wellsprings of Islamic Culture".

We note that the forum runs for four days and comprises a scholarly programme taking in the academic sessions, the symposia and the workshops, and is then followed by the training programme, which runs for five consecutive days and concludes with the closing session and the recommendations.

flags.context: the opening of the second sentence about the symposium
options: read as الملتقى — 'this forum', as the same word is spelled twice elsewhere in the record
read المتلقى literally — 'the recipient', which the sentence cannot support
flags.note: Source typo: transposed letters in الملتقى. Preserved in body_ar, rendered on the obvious reading, flagged rather than fixed per style guide section 11.

flags.arabic: أثر الاستعمار في تغريب اللسان الإفريقي وقطعه عن منابع الثقافة الإسلامية
flags.context: the title of the Sheikh's lecture, given but not summarised
options: render the title and supply nothing
treat the title as indicating his position
flags.note: The record gives the title of the lecture and not one word of its content. A reader may reasonably infer the thesis from the title, but the corpus has no text for it: nothing of the argument, its evidence or its qualifications exists here. تغريب is rendered 'Westernising' rather than 'alienating' — both are live senses of the root, and the pairing with 'cutting it off from the wellsprings of Islamic culture' supports the former; recorded here because the lecture title will be quoted.

translator_notes: A news-desk announcement. It reports the Sheikh's participation and the title of one lecture, and carries none of his words.
The CMS timestamp, 10 March 2012, is a bulk-upload date. The body's internal dates are consistent with March 2012.

The Sheikh is styled 'president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University' here and 'president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars' in records 784, 785 and 789 of this same slice. Both offices are his; the variation is the source's.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يحاضر لجمعية الفتاة في ذكرى الاستقلال عن "مفهوم المواطنة ومقوماتها"
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures to the Young Woman's Association on the Anniversary of Independence on 'The Concept of Citizenship and Its Constituents'
body_ar:
استضافت جمعية الفتاة للتوعية ومكافحة التسرب المدرسي مساء أمس 14 محرم 1434هـ الموافق (لذكرى عيد الاستقلال الوطني الثاني والخمسون)- 28 نوفمبر 2012م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو حفظه الله في محاضرة هامة ألقاها تحت عنوان: "مفهوم المواطنة ومقوماتها" وسط إقبال كثيف من طرف مئات الشباب والنساء والشيوخ والأطفال غصت بهم جوانب مدرج المعرفة بكلية الحقوق والاقتصاد بجامعة انواكشوط.

وقد تحدث الشيخ في بداية محاضرته عن ارتباط الإنسان بوطنه وحرصه على مبادئه الوطنية السامية وقيّمه العليا التي تمثل إنسانيته، مستشهدا في ذلك بأمثلة سامية ونيرة من هدي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وحبه لموطنه الأصلي "المدينة المنورة" التي أخرج منها قسرا، وكان كلما عنّت له بيوت المدينة قال: "تلك طيبة طابت.." وقال "اللهم حبب إلينا المدينة كحبنا مكة وأشد..".

وقد أشاد الشيخ الددو بمساهمة الموريتانيين في مقاومة المستعمر، وذكر نماذج بارزة من أشكال المقاومة التي واجهت الإستعمار الفرنسي إبان دخوله إلى موريتانيا، مبرزا أصنافها الثقافية والدينية والعسكرية، وقد تناول الشيخ مواضيع مهمة في هذه المحاضرة، نذكر منها:

• التأكيد على أهمية وحدة أهل الوطن الواحد

• التأكيد على أهمية التطلع للعزة والكرامة

• حث الطلاب على السعي إلى رفع مستواهم العلمي والثقافي

• محاربة التسرب المدرسي

• من ضرورات المواطنة تشجيع النوابغ العلمية في الجامعات

• من حقوق المواطنة وعي الإنسان بواجباته وحقوقه

• العمل السياسي الذي يرتكز على التوعية والمدافعة بالتي هي أحسن

• الحرص على الوحدة الوطنية مطلب شرعي ووطني واخلاقي

• الإقصاء للأطراف الأخرى مرفوض في السياسة

• من أهميات المواطنة تسلح الناس بالمعارف المفيدة والنافعة والمؤثرة كالإعلام..

• من مقتضيات روح المواطنة السعي للتغيير والإصلاح في كل شيء

• من أمثلة ذلك قصيدة رائعة في الاستسقاء للشيخ محمد المامي

• ضرورات المواطنة الصالحة من خلال قصيدة الشيخ محمد المامي في الاستسقاء

• وخلال حديثه أشاد الشيخ الددو بالدور الذي لعبه العلماء والأمراء وعامة المجتمع في المقاومة الثقافية والجهادية ضد المستعمر

• الدعاء

وفي نهاية المحاضرة شكر فضيلة الشيخ حفظه الله مجهود الجمعية في تنشئة الأجيال تنشئة إسلامية صحيحة، والسعي لتميزهم التربوي والأخلاقي، داعيا الله التوفيق للقائمين على الجمعية.

لمتابعة المحاضرة في قسم الفكر الإسلامي إضغط هنا.
body_en:
The Young Woman's Association for Awareness-Raising and Combating School Dropout hosted yesterday evening, 14 Muharram 1434 AH, corresponding to (the fifty-second anniversary of the national Independence Day) — 28 November 2012, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew (may God preserve him) for an important lecture he delivered under the title 'The Concept of Citizenship and Its Constituents', amid a heavy turnout of hundreds of young people, women, elders and children who packed the sides of the Knowledge Lecture Hall at the Faculty of Law and Economics of the University of Nouakchott.

At the beginning of his lecture the Sheikh spoke of a person's bond with his homeland and his care for its lofty national principles and its highest values, which represent his humanity, citing in this elevated and illuminating examples from the guidance of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and his love for his original homeland, 'Medina the Illuminated', from which he was driven out by force; whenever the houses of Medina came into his view he would say, 'That is Ṭaybah, and good it is…', and he said, 'O God, make Medina beloved to us as we love Mecca, and more so…'

Sheikh al-Dedew praised the contribution of Mauritanians to the resistance against the coloniser, and mentioned prominent instances of the forms of resistance that confronted French colonialism when it entered Mauritania, bringing out its cultural, religious and military varieties. The Sheikh took up important subjects in this lecture, among which we mention:

• Emphasising the importance of the unity of the people of a single homeland

• Emphasising the importance of aspiring to honour and dignity

• Urging students to strive to raise their scholarly and cultural level

• Combating school dropout

• Among the requirements of citizenship is the encouragement of outstanding scholarly talent in the universities

• Among the rights of citizenship is a person's awareness of his duties and his rights

• Political work that rests on raising awareness and on contending in the way that is best

• Concern for national unity is a demand of the Sharia, of the nation and of morality

• The exclusion of other parties is rejected in politics

• Among the things that matter in citizenship is that people equip themselves with beneficial, useful and effective forms of knowledge, such as media work…

• Among what the spirit of citizenship requires is striving for change and reform in everything

• An example of this is a magnificent poem on the prayer for rain by Shaykh Muhammad al-Mami

• The requirements of sound citizenship, by way of Shaykh Muhammad al-Mami's poem on the prayer for rain

• In the course of his talk Sheikh al-Dedew praised the role played by the scholars, the emirs and the general public in the cultural resistance and the resistance of jihad against the coloniser

• Supplication

At the end of the lecture His Eminence the Sheikh (may God preserve him) thanked the association for its effort in raising the generations upon a sound Islamic upbringing, and in striving for their educational and moral distinction, praying that God grant success to those who run the association.

To follow the lecture in the Islamic Thought section, click here.

flags.arabic: وحبه لموطنه الأصلي "المدينة المنورة" التي أخرج منها قسرا
flags.context: report of the Sheikh's opening remarks on attachment to one's homeland
options: translate as the source has it and flag the apparent error
read "موطنه الأصلي" as Mecca, with "المدينة المنورة" a reporter's slip
read "أخرج منها قسرا" as attaching to Mecca, not Medina
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). As written, the sentence calls Medina the Prophet's original homeland and says he was forcibly expelled from it; he was expelled from Mecca, and Medina was the place of emigration. This is a reporter's error in the news write-up, not the Sheikh's own words, but it has been translated exactly as it stands rather than silently corrected. The Sheikh's office should confirm the intended wording.

flags.arabic: تلك طيبة طابت.. / اللهم حبب إلينا المدينة كحبنا مكة وأشد..
flags.context: two prophetic reports quoted from memory in the lecture report
options: render the wording as printed, with the ellipses left visible
render against the standard wording in the collections
flags.note: Both quotations are truncated in the source (the ellipses are the source's). No collection or grading is given by the reporter, and none has been supplied. The second is close to the supplication in al-Bukhari's Ṣaḥīḥ, but the wording differs and no attribution is added here (style guide §4).

translator_notes: News report of a lecture, not a legal text. 'جمعية الفتاة' is rendered 'the Young Woman's Association' as the organisation's own name. 'المدافعة بالتي هي أحسن' echoes the Qur'anic idiom (cf. Sūrat Fuṣṣilat 41:34) and is rendered 'contending in the way that is best'. The bulleted list is a reporter's summary of headings, not the Sheikh's continuous speech, and is kept as a list. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يحاضر بالمعهد العالي عن "الاقتصاد الإسلامي ودوره في التنمية"
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures at the Higher Institute on 'The Islamic Economy and Its Role in Development'
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء ورئيس جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم ورئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين محاضرة علمية هامة صباح اليوم الأحد 18 محرم 1434 هـ الموافق 02 دسمبر 2012م في المعهد العالي للدراسات والبحوث الإسلامية تحت عنوان: "الاقتصاد الإسلامي.. ودوره في التنمية"، في الساعة العاشرة صباحا.

وقد نُظمت المحاضرة ضمن ندوة علمية أشرف عليها طلاب السنة الرابعة من شعبة الاقتصاد الإسلامي

وجرت المحاضرة وسط حضور طلابي كبير غصت به جوانب المدرج، واستمرت المحاضرة لمدة ساعة ونصف.

وسينشر الموقع – إن شاء الله – المحاضرة بعد قليل.

لمتابعة المحاضرة اضغط هنا.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, president of the Future Association for Calling People to Islam (daʿwah), Culture and Education, and president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University, delivered an important scholarly lecture this morning, Sunday 18 Muharram 1434 AH, corresponding to 02 December 2012, at the Higher Institute for Islamic Studies and Research, under the title 'The Islamic Economy… and Its Role in Development', at ten o'clock in the morning.

The lecture was organised as part of a scholarly symposium supervised by the fourth-year students of the Islamic Economics division

The lecture took place before a large student audience that packed the sides of the lecture hall, and it continued for an hour and a half.

The site will publish the lecture — God willing — shortly.

To follow the lecture, click here.
translator_notes: Short announcement. The lecture itself is not on this page; the page promises it will be published later and carries a 'click here' link whose target is no longer present in the markup, so the English keeps the sentence without a working destination. Second paragraph ends without a full stop in the source; reproduced as such. 'دسمبر' in the source is a spelling variant of 'ديسمبر'. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يستقبل رئيس حركة النهضة راشد الغنوشي في مركز تكوين العلماء
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Receives the President of the Ennahda Movement, Rached Ghannouchi, at the Centre for the Formation of Scholars
body_ar:
استقبل العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء مساء أمس الخميس 08 صفر 1434هـ الموافق: 21 دجنبر 2012م رئيس حركة النهضة التونسية والمفكر الإسلامي راشد الغنوشي

وكان في استقبال رئيس حركة النهضة فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء والمدير العام للمركز الدكتور محمد المختار ولد محمد المامي، ولفيف من العلماء والإداريين من المركز وخارجه.

وخلال استراحتهم في قاعة الاستقبال تم تقديم عرض تعريفي عن المركز، وبعض المشاريع التعليمية والتنموية التي يرعاها، كما تناول اللقاء أحاديث ودية وآفاق وسبل التعاون في الاستفادة من التجربة الطويلة والرائدة لحركة النهضة الإسلامية التونسية.

وقد رافق الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو الشيخ راشد الغنوشي في جولة بين مختلف مرافق مركز تكوين العلماء، حيث زارا مكتبة المركز، ومكاتبه الإدارية، وسكن الطلاب ومطعم المركز، كما عاينا عن قرب المقر الجديد لتدريس قسم العالمات والأقسام التحضيرية اللذين تم افتتاحهما لأول مرة مطلع العام الدراسي الجاري.

وخلال الجولة التي قاما بها فوق سطوح البنايات ألقيا نظرة على أعمال بناء المسجد الجديد بجانب المركز، الذي سيكون بحول الله قريبا المسجد الجامع الكبير الذي يسع مئات الآلاف من المصلين، كما تعتزم إدارة المركز تحويل مبنى المسجد الحالي بعد الانتهاء من المسجد الجديد إلى محظرة مفتوحة ومكتبة عامة تتبعان للمركز.

وقد أدلى رئيس حركة النهضة التونسية راشد الغنوشي بتصريح رسمي لمكتب الإعلام بالمركز بعيد الجولة التي قام بها رفقة الشيخ الددو والوفد المرافق، قال فيه إنه يحمد الله تعالى على زيارة "هذا الإنجاز الذي أجراه الله على يد العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو"، مضيفا أن الشيخ الددو من خلال مركز تكوين العلماء "برهن على أن في الإسلام تجديدا معاصرا، وأن في الإسلام المعاصر إحياء للحضارة الإسلامية،

وأضاف الغنوشي أن شنقيط عاصمة الحضارة الإسلامية تتجدد اليوم عن طريق هذا المعلم، خصوصا وأنه حمل على عاتقه أمانة عظيمة، وشرفا عظيما؛ شرف تجديد العلم الإسلامي، والتجديد المعاصر لبعث طبقة علمائية حديثة متسلحة بأصول الإسلام، وبما أنتجته الحداثة المعاصرة من وسائل تقنية لتجديد العلوم والمعارف".

واعتبر الشيخ الغنوشي أن موريتانيا ومن خلال مركز تكوين العلماء تبرهن على أنها "مستقر الحضارة الإسلامية، ومستقر العلم الشرعي، فقها مالكيا، وأصولا، وحديثا وأدبا".

وأثنى الشيخ الغنوشي على ما وصفه "بالطموح الذي دفع الشيخ محمد الحسن إلى إبراز علمائية إسلامية حديثة ومعاصرة"، مجددا تهنئة موريتانيا "بهذا المعلم وبهذا التجديد".
body_en:
The erudite scholar Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, received yesterday evening, Thursday 08 Safar 1434 AH, corresponding to 21 December 2012, the president of the Tunisian Ennahda Movement and Islamic thinker Rached Ghannouchi

Receiving the president of the Ennahda Movement were His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, the Centre's director-general Dr Muhammad al-Mukhtar Ould Muhammad al-Mami, and a company of scholars and administrators from the Centre and from outside it.

While they rested in the reception hall, an introductory presentation was given about the Centre and about some of the educational and development projects it sponsors. The meeting also took in cordial conversation and the prospects for, and means of, cooperation in drawing on the long and pioneering experience of the Tunisian Islamic Ennahda Movement.

Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew accompanied Shaykh Rached Ghannouchi on a tour of the various facilities of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, where the two visited the Centre's library, its administrative offices, the students' residence and the Centre's refectory. They also inspected at close hand the new premises for teaching the women scholars' department and the preparatory departments, both of which were opened for the first time at the beginning of the current academic year.

During the tour they made across the roofs of the buildings, the two cast an eye over the construction work on the new mosque beside the Centre, which will soon, by God's power, be the great congregational mosque, holding hundreds of thousands of worshippers. The Centre's administration also intends, once the new mosque is completed, to convert the present mosque building into an open traditional teaching circle (maḥẓarah) and a public library, both attached to the Centre.

The president of the Tunisian Ennahda Movement, Rached Ghannouchi, gave an official statement to the Centre's media office shortly after the tour he made in the company of Sheikh al-Dedew and the accompanying delegation, in which he said that he praises God the Exalted for visiting 'this achievement that God has brought about at the hands of the erudite scholar Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew', adding that Sheikh al-Dedew, through the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, 'has demonstrated that there is a contemporary renewal within Islam, and that within contemporary Islam there is a revival of Islamic civilisation,

Ghannouchi added that Shinqit, the capital of Islamic civilisation, is renewing itself today by way of this landmark, particularly as it has taken upon itself a great trust (amānah) and a great honour: the honour of renewing Islamic learning, and of contemporary renewal for the raising up of a modern class of scholars, equipped with the foundations of Islam and with what contemporary modernity has produced by way of technical means for renewing the sciences and the branches of knowledge.'

Shaykh Ghannouchi held that Mauritania, by way of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, demonstrates that it is 'the settled home of Islamic civilisation and the settled home of the religious sciences — in Maliki jurisprudence, in legal theory, in hadith and in letters'.

Shaykh Ghannouchi praised what he described as 'the ambition that drove Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan to bring forth a modern and contemporary Islamic scholarship', renewing his congratulations to Mauritania 'on this landmark and on this renewal'.

flags.arabic: "برهن على أن في الإسلام تجديدا معاصرا … لتجديد العلوم والمعارف".
flags.context: Ghannouchi's official statement, spanning two paragraphs
options: treat the quotation as running across both paragraphs, closing where the source closes it
close the quotation at the end of the first paragraph and treat the second as reported speech
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). The quotation opens in one paragraph and is not closed there; a closing mark appears only at the end of the following paragraph, which is itself introduced as reported speech ('وأضاف الغنوشي أن…'). The English reproduces the source's punctuation rather than deciding where the direct quotation ends.

flags.context: تحويل مبنى المسجد الحالي … إلى محظرة مفتوحة ومكتبة عامة
options: traditional teaching circle (maḥẓarah)
traditional Mauritanian seminary (maḥẓarah)
open study circle
flags.note: Mauritanian institution with no exact English equivalent: the mobile or mosque-based teaching circle of the Shinqiti tradition in which the Sheikh himself was trained. 'مفتوحة' here most likely means open-access rather than open-air. Not yet in the project glossary; a fixed rendering should be set corpus-wide.

flags.context: المقر الجديد لتدريس قسم العالمات والأقسام التحضيرية
options: the women scholars' department
the department for training female scholars
the ʿālimāt programme
flags.note: 'العالمات' is the feminine plural of ʿālim, so the department trains women as scholars. Rendered so, but the Centre's own English name for this department should be used if it has one.

translator_notes: News report of a visit. Proper names use the spellings their bearers use in Latin script (Rached Ghannouchi, Ennahda). 'دجنبر' is the Maghrebi form of December. First paragraph ends without a full stop in the source. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يتسلم درعا من المركز الثقافي المصري تقديرا لجهوده العلمية
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Receives a Shield from the Egyptian Cultural Centre in Appreciation of His Scholarly Efforts
body_ar:
استضاف المركز الثقافي المصري بانواكشوط مساء أمس الأحد 11 صفر 1434هـ الموافق 24 ديسمبر 2012م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو حفظه الله في محاضرة هامة نظمها المركز ضمن أنشطة معرض الكتاب الذي يقيمه المركز الثقافي المصري حاليا بانواكشوط، وقد تناولت المحاضرة موضوع "فضل العلم ".

وقد أشاد الشيخ الددو بدور المركز الثقافي المصري في نشر العلم والثقافة الإسلامية والعربية منذ عقود في موريتانيا، مشيرا إلى أن مكتبته كانت قبلة للزوار ، ومقصدا للشباب المتعطش إلى المطالعة، أيام كانت هي المكتبة الوحيدة بالعاصمة انواكشوط .

وفي نهاية المحاضرة سلّم القائم بالأعمال في السفارة المصرية للشيخ درعا تقديريا من السفارة المصرية بانواكشوط اعترافا منها بجهوده النبيلة في نشر العلم الشرعي والثقافة الإسلامية الأصيلة.

وقبل ذلك تجول الشيخ في "معرض الكتاب المصري" الموجود بالمركز نفسه، واشترى عدة كتب ، ووعد الجهة المنظمة للمعرض بإرسال نسخ من مؤلفاته لهم ، لنشرها في المعرض .

وسينشر الموقع – إن شاء الله- المحاضرة قريبا.
body_en:
The Egyptian Cultural Centre in Nouakchott hosted yesterday evening, Sunday 11 Safar 1434 AH, corresponding to 24 December 2012, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew (may God preserve him) for an important lecture organised by the Centre as part of the activities of the book fair that the Egyptian Cultural Centre is currently holding in Nouakchott. The lecture took up the subject of 'The Merit of Knowledge'.

Sheikh al-Dedew praised the role of the Egyptian Cultural Centre in spreading learning and Islamic and Arabic culture in Mauritania over the decades, pointing out that its library used to be a focal point for visitors and a destination for young people thirsty for reading, in the days when it was the only library in the capital Nouakchott.

At the end of the lecture, the chargé d'affaires at the Egyptian embassy presented the Sheikh with a commemorative shield from the Egyptian embassy in Nouakchott, in acknowledgement of his noble efforts in spreading the religious sciences and authentic Islamic culture.

Before that, the Sheikh went round the 'Egyptian Book Fair' held at the Centre itself, bought several books, and promised the body organising the fair that he would send them copies of his own works to be distributed at the fair.

The site will publish the lecture — God willing — shortly.

flags.context: سلّم القائم بالأعمال في السفارة المصرية للشيخ درعا تقديريا
options: a commemorative shield
a plaque of appreciation
an award shield
flags.note: 'درع' is the standard Arab-world term for the shield-shaped presentation plaque given at ceremonies. 'Shield' is kept in the title to match the Arabic; 'plaque' would read more naturally in English. A house choice should be made once, corpus-wide.

translator_notes: Short news report. 'العلم الشرعي' rendered 'the religious sciences' — the body of Islamic learning, not 'Sharia law'. The lecture referred to is not on this page. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يلقي كلمة في افتتاح مركز شنقيط للمالية الإسلامية بفندق الخيمة
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers an Address at the Opening of the Shinqit Centre for Islamic Finance at the Khaima Hotel
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين كلمة في افتتاح مركز شنقيط للمالية الإسلامية، الذي تم الإعلان عن إطلاقه اليوم الثلاثاء 12 صفر 1434هـ الموافق 25 ديسنبر 2012م

وقد حضر فعاليات الافتتاح جمع غفير من موظفي المصارف الإسلامية والبنوك الموريتانية وخاصة المديرين الكبار، ورجال الأعمال المهتمين بالمالية الإسلامية.

وتناول الشيخ في كلمته في افتتاح المركز تبيين الحاجة الماسة لمثل هذه المراكز والدراسات، وانه جاء ليسد فراغا كبيرا في المعاملات الإسلامية، وبين أن المركز يريد له القائمون عليه أن يكون مركزا دوليا معتمدا في شؤون الاقتصاد الإسلامي، وذكر الشيخ أن الساحة المصرفية في موريتانيا تشهد إقبالا كبيرا من البنوك الإسلامية المحلية والدولية.

وقد ذكر الشيخ أن أهمية هذا النوع من المراكز بحاجة إلى وجود مفكرين وأصحاب تجارب في مجال الرقابة الشرعية. مبيناً أن هذا المركز سيكون حريصا على توافقه مع القانون ومنضبطا مع مقتضيات الشرع وسيسعى إلى تقليل المخاطرة في معاملاته المصرفية وتقليص الفوائد الربحية على المعاملات..

وتخلل الحفل كلمات لمممثلي البنوك والمصارف الإسلامية في موريتانيا من بينها كلمة لمدير بنك المعاملات الصحيحة الإسلامي، وكلمة لمدير البنك الوطني للمعاملات الإسلامية..

يُذكر أن هذا المركز ترعاه جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين وتديره نخبة من الأساتذة والدكاترة المتميزين في العلوم الشرعية بشكل عام وفي المالية الإسلامية بشكل خاص، بما فيها الوقف والزكاة، إلى جانب مختصين في الاقتصاد الإسلامي والمحاسبة والقانون وفي مقدمتهم فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين.

ويهدف هذا المركز إلى خدمة المالية الإسلامية من خلال التدريب والتاهيل والبحث والنشر والرقابة والتدقيق والمراجعة والاستشارة الشرعية والقانونية، وإلى إيجاد وتطوير البدائل الشرعية للمعاملات الربوية في المجال المالي.

كما أن ضمن أهدافه تشجيع المؤسسات المالية الربوية على التحول الآمن إلى مؤسسات تتقيد بالحلال.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University, delivered an address at the opening of the Shinqit Centre for Islamic Finance, whose launch was announced today, Tuesday 12 Safar 1434 AH, corresponding to 25 December 2012

The opening proceedings were attended by a large gathering of staff of the Islamic financial houses and the Mauritanian banks, senior directors in particular, and by businessmen with an interest in Islamic finance.

In his address at the opening of the Centre, the Sheikh took up the setting out of the pressing need for centres and studies of this kind, and that it has come to fill a large gap in Islamic transactions (muʿāmalāt). He made clear that those running the Centre want it to be an accredited international centre in the affairs of the Islamic economy, and the Sheikh mentioned that the banking scene in Mauritania is seeing a large influx of local and international Islamic banks.

The Sheikh mentioned that the importance of this kind of centre requires the presence of thinkers and of people with experience in the field of Sharia supervision, making clear that this Centre will be careful to be in conformity with the law and disciplined by what the Sharia requires, and that it will seek to reduce risk in its banking transactions and to cut back the profit returns on transactions…

The ceremony included addresses by representatives of the banks and Islamic financial houses in Mauritania, among them an address by the director of the Bank of Sound Transactions (Islamic), and an address by the director of the National Bank for Islamic Transactions…

It is worth noting that this Centre is sponsored by Abdullah ibn Yasin University and is run by a select group of professors and doctors distinguished in the religious sciences generally and in Islamic finance in particular, including endowments (waqf) and zakat, alongside specialists in Islamic economics, accountancy and law, foremost among them His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University.

This Centre aims to serve Islamic finance through training, qualification, research, publication, supervision, auditing, review, and Sharia and legal consultancy, and to find and develop Sharia-compliant alternatives to usurious (ribā-based) transactions in the financial field.

Also among its aims is to encourage usurious financial institutions to convert safely into institutions that keep within what is lawful (ḥalāl).

flags.context: وسيسعى إلى تقليل المخاطرة في معاملاته المصرفية وتقليص الفوائد الربحية على المعاملات
options: cut back the profit returns on transactions
cut back the interest-bearing returns on transactions
reduce the profit margins charged on transactions
flags.note: 'الفوائد الربحية' is not a settled technical term and the phrase is internally odd: فائدة is the standard Arabic word for interest, while ربحية points to profit. Since the speaker is describing an Islamic finance body, 'interest' cannot be what is meant as a product feature, so 'profit returns' is used. A reviewer with the Sheikh's own wording should fix this; the ruling significance is real, because the sentence otherwise reads as though an Islamic centre were undertaking to reduce rather than eliminate interest.

flags.arabic: بنك المعاملات الصحيحة الإسلامي / البنك الوطني للمعاملات الإسلامية
flags.context: كلمات لممثلي البنوك والمصارف الإسلامية في موريتانيا
options: translate the names literally
use the institutions' own registered French or English names
flags.note: Two Mauritanian bank names given only in Arabic. Rendered literally; the institutions' own registered names (Mauritanian banks normally trade under French names) should replace these once confirmed. Note the translation of 'صحيحة' here as 'sound' in the sense of valid transactions, per the glossary entry for ṣaḥīḥ.

translator_notes: News report of an opening ceremony. 'المصارف' and 'البنوك' are both used in the source and are distinguished as 'financial houses' and 'banks'. Source typos preserved in body_ar: 'ديسنبر' for 'ديسمبر', 'لمممثلي' for 'لممثلي', 'التاهيل' for 'التأهيل'. First paragraph ends without a full stop in the source. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في اجتماع مجلس أمناء الاتحاد بوصفه عضوا ورئيسا للجنة العضوية
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the Union's Board of Trustees Meeting as a Member and as Chair of the Membership Committee
body_ar:
شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في الاجتماع الرابع لمجلس أمناء الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين في دورته الثالثة 2014-2010 المنعقد بمدينة الدوحة يومي 2-3 صفر 1434هـ الموافق 15-16 ديسمبر 2012.

ويشارك الشيخ الددو بوصفه عضوا في المجلس ورئيسا للجنة العضوية، وقد استمر الاجتماع لمدة يومين ناقش فيهما المجلس الخطط السنوية والميزانيات والمستجدات كما ناقشوا فيهما العديد من القضايا الادارية والهيكلية وبحثوا سبل العلاج لعدد من القضايا ومشاكل العالم الاسلامي.

وشارك في الاجتماع سبعة وثلاثون عضواً من مختلف دول العالم الإسلامي.

وبعد مناقشة جدول الأعمال المقرر والتحاور بشأن القضايا المطروحة للاجتماع وخلال يومين كاملين أصدر المجلس عددا من القرارات والتوصيات شملت كل القضايا المطروحة على الساحة الاسلامية مبينا رأيه في كل حالة من الحالات المعروضة في الاجتماع.

للاطلاع على تفاصيل أكثر في الموضوع يرجى زيارة موقع الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين على الرابط التالي:

http://www.iumsonline.net/ar/Default.asp?ContentID=5376&menuID=6
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took part in the fourth meeting of the board of trustees of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, in its third term 2010–2014, held in the city of Doha on 2–3 Safar 1434 AH, corresponding to 15–16 December 2012.

Sheikh al-Dedew takes part as a member of the board and as chair of the membership committee. The meeting continued for two days, in which the board discussed the annual plans, the budgets and current developments, and in which they also discussed many administrative and structural matters and examined ways of remedying a number of the issues and problems of the Islamic world.

Thirty-seven members from various countries of the Islamic world took part in the meeting.

After discussing the set agenda and deliberating on the matters put before the meeting, over two full days, the board issued a number of decisions and recommendations covering all the matters current on the Islamic scene, setting out its view on each of the cases presented at the meeting.

To see further detail on the subject, please visit the website of the International Union of Muslim Scholars at the following link:

http://www.iumsonline.net/ar/Default.asp?ContentID=5376&menuID=6

flags.context: الاجتماع الرابع لمجلس أمناء الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين في دورته الثالثة 2014-2010
options: third term 2010–2014
reproduce the digits in the source order, 2014-2010
flags.note: The year range is written right-to-left in the Arabic, so the digits appear as '2014-2010'. Rendered in the English reading order as 2010–2014. This is a rendering convention, not a correction of the source.

flags.context: closing line of the report
options: keep the link as printed
drop the link
flags.note: The link is printed as plain text in the source, not as an anchor, and the target no longer resolves. Kept as printed; the site should not present it as a live link without checking.

translator_notes: Short news report. The report's own dating is internally consistent (2–3 Safar 1434 = 15–16 December 2012) but sits more than two weeks before the CMS upload timestamp of 2 January 2013 — a further instance of the corpus-wide defect that CMS dates are upload timestamps, not composition dates. 'الاتحاد' in the title is elliptical for the International Union of Muslim Scholars and is expanded in the English.

title_ar: الشيخ الددو يحاضر عن "خصائص الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأمته" بلكصر
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures on 'The Distinctive Qualities of the Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him) and of His Community' in Ksar
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء مساء أمس السبت 07 ربيع الأول 1434هـ الموافق 19 يناير 2013 م بمسجد بداه بمقاطعة لكصر، محاضرة هامة حول"خصائص الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأمته" استمرت ساعتين، وقد شهدت إقبالا لافتا من الرجال والنساء اكتظ منه الجامع، وسد الطرق المؤدية إليه

و قد تناولت المحاضرة المواضيع التالية:

*-اختيار الله تعالى لرسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم.

*-وأبرز الخصائص التي اختصه بها سبحانه وتعالى كالشفاعة الكبرى والصغرى والوسطى،

وخصائص أمته؛ فهم الآخرون الساقون يوم القيامة، وعملهم فليل و أجرهم مضاعف..

وتحدث الشيخ خلال المحاضرة عن مراتب الشهادة. و جوالب المحبة التي حصرها في: الجمال والإحسان، والخلق، والرجاء، والعلاقة، وكيف اجتمعت في رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

وقد استطرد قصصا في محبته صلى الله عليه وسلم.. مؤكدا أن الإقبال على الله تعالى علاج نهائي للفقر والحاجة.

وأوضح الشيخ الددو أن الدعاة إلى الله تعالى هم ورثة الأنبياء، و أنه يكفي آخر هذه الأمة شرفا قوله تعالى: "وآخرين منهم لما يلحقوا بهم"

وقوله -صلى الله عليه وسلم- لأصحابه: "أنتم في زمان من نقص فيه عن عُشُر ما أمر به هلك، وسيأتي على الناس زمان من أتى فيه بعشر ما أمر به نجا".

-وقد أم الشيخ الحاضرين في صلاة العشاء، و دعا إلى تخفيف الزحام في الصفوف، معتبرا أن شدة الزحام لاتتأتى معها إقامة الصلاة المطلوبة، مما دعى لخروج كثيرين للصلاة خارج المسجد!

وبعد الصلاة أجاب على أسئلة الحضور، وختم بدعاء جامع مؤثر..
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered yesterday evening, Saturday 07 Rabiʿ al-Awwal 1434 AH, corresponding to 19 January 2013, at the Bedah Mosque in the district of Ksar, an important lecture on 'The Distinctive Qualities of the Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him) and of His Community', which lasted two hours and saw a striking turnout of men and women, so that the congregational mosque was packed and the roads leading to it were blocked

The lecture took up the following subjects:

*- God the Exalted's choosing of His Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him).

*- And the most prominent distinctive qualities with which He, glorified and exalted, singled him out, such as the greater, the lesser and the intermediate intercession,

and the distinctive qualities of his community: they are the last [in time], the foremost on the Day of Resurrection; their work is little and their reward is multiplied…

During the lecture the Sheikh spoke about the ranks of bearing witness, and about the things that draw love, which he confined to: beauty, doing good, character, hope and relationship — and how these came together in the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him)

He went on at length with stories about love for him (peace and blessings be upon him)… affirming that turning to God the Exalted is a final remedy for poverty and need.

Sheikh al-Dedew explained that those who call people to God the Exalted are the heirs of the prophets, and that it is honour enough for the last of this community that God the Exalted says: { and others of them who have not yet joined them } (Sūrat al-Jumuʿah 62:3)

and that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to his Companions: 'You are in a time in which whoever falls short of a tenth of what he is commanded will perish; and a time will come upon people in which whoever brings a tenth of what he is commanded will be saved.'

- The Sheikh led those present in the night prayer (ʿishāʾ), and called for the crowding in the rows to be eased, holding that with such severe crowding the prayer cannot be performed as it is required to be — which led many to go out and pray outside the mosque!

After the prayer he answered the questions of those present, and closed with a comprehensive and moving supplication…

flags.context: listing the distinctive qualities of the Prophet's community
options: the last [in time], the foremost on the Day of Resurrection (reading الساقون as a misprint for السابقون)
leave the word unresolved
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). 'الساقون' is not a word that fits; the phrase is the well-known prophetic saying 'نحن الآخِرون السابقون يوم القيامة' — the last of the communities in time, the first to be judged on the Day of Resurrection. Translated by the evident sense and flagged; 'body_ar' preserves the source spelling. The same paragraph has 'فليل' for 'قليل'.

flags.context: وتحدث الشيخ خلال المحاضرة عن مراتب الشهادة
options: the ranks of bearing witness
the ranks of martyrdom (shahādah)
the degrees of the testimony of faith
flags.note: شهادة carries all three senses and the one-line summary gives no context to settle which. In a lecture on the Prophet's distinctive qualities, 'bearing witness' (as in the community bearing witness over mankind, Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:143) fits well, but martyrdom is at least as likely in a Mauritanian lecture of this period. Rendered neutrally as 'bearing witness'. DO NOT publish without the lecture audio being checked — the three senses point in very different directions.

flags.arabic: جوالب المحبة … الجمال والإحسان، والخلق، والرجاء، والعلاقة
flags.context: the five things the Sheikh said draw love
options: beauty, doing good, character, hope and relationship
beauty, benefaction, moral character, expectation and kinship
beauty, excellence, disposition, hope and connection
flags.note: A five-item list compressed into single words by the reporter, with no gloss on any of them. 'العلاقة' in particular could be kinship, attachment or an established connection. Each is rendered with its most general English sense; the list should be checked against the lecture before it is presented as the Sheikh's own scheme.

flags.arabic: "أنتم في زمان من نقص فيه عن عُشُر ما أمر به هلك…"
flags.context: a prophetic report quoted in the lecture
options: translate the wording as printed, with no grading added
translate against the standard wording in the collections
flags.note: The report is known from al-Tirmidhi and others, usually with 'من ترك منكم عشر ما أمر به'. The reporter gives neither collection nor grading, and per style guide §4 none has been supplied. The wording here differs from the common form and is translated as printed.

translator_notes: News summary of a lecture; the substance is a reporter's list of headings, not the Sheikh's continuous words. Qur'anic rendering is interpretive and is not a substitute for the Arabic (style guide §4). The Hijri date given here, 07 Rabiʿ al-Awwal 1434, is matched to 19 January 2013, whereas article 820 matches the same Hijri date to 18 January 2013; both cannot be right. Source typos preserved in body_ar: 'الساقون' for 'السابقون', 'فليل' for 'قليل', 'دعى' for 'دعا'. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو في زيارة لدولة ليبيا الشقيقة
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew on a Visit to the Sister State of Libya
body_ar:
أدى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ، رئيس مركزتكوين العلماء، بحر الأسبوع المنصرم ، زيارة موسعة لدولة ليبيا الشقيقة ، وقد شملت الزيارة بعض المراكز الإسلامية في ليبيا ، إضافة إلى لقاء بعض المسؤولين الكبار وصلاة الجمعة بمسجد مراد أغا بتاجوراء.

وقد استقبل الشيخ من لدن فضيلة المفتي الشيخ الصادق بن عبد الرحمن الغرياني في مكتبه بدار الإفتاء بطرابلس صباح يوم الخميس (7/مارس/2013م)، في لقاء ودي استعرضا خلاله أهم المستجدات في المنطقة وسبل التعاون من أجل النهوض بواقع الأمة.

و في لقاء جمعه مع محافظ مصرف ليبيا المركزي”الصديق الكبير”صباح الخميس (7 /مارس ) بمقر مصرف ليبيا المركزي في طرابلس أكّد عضو الاتحاد العالمي للعلماء المسلمين الشيخ”محمد الحسن الددو”على ضرورة تعجيل الخُطَى نحو تحقيق الاستقرار الاقتصادي الليبي وإدارة عجلته لأنه – وبحسب وصفه – أولوية تساهم في استقرار البلد بصفة عامة، بالتعاون بين مؤسسات الدولة ووزاراتها.

اللقاء كان مناسبة ناقش فيها الشيخ مع المسؤولين في المصرف المركزي مشروع الصيرفة الإسلامية الذي أطلقه خلال الفترة القريبة الماضية، حيث أكّد العلامة محمد الحسن الددو على جدوى هذا التحول الجاد وتأثيره الإيجابي على الحياة والاقتصاد الليبي بصفة عامة إذا طبّق على الوجه الصحيح.

وإضافة إلى ذلك قام الشيخ الددو بزيارة لوزارة الأوقاف بالحكومة الانتقالية المؤقتة التقى فيها بالوزير المكلّف بالوزارة ووكيل الوزارة وعدد من المديرين ومسؤولي الأقسام داخل الوزارة، وتطرق اللقاء لتفعيل دور المساجد في ليبيا خصوصا في عملية البناء والتوعية التي تتطلبها مرحلة التحول في ليبيا.

وشدد الددو على ضرورة التواصل مع كافة الاتجاهات الفكرية والأطراف في ليبيا والتحاور والنقاش العلمي الموسّع بين العلماء وطلاب العلم، إضافة إلى دعوة العلماء والفقهاء من كل الأقطار الإسلامية وتوسيع دائرة التواصل مع العالم والأفكار والرموز الإسلامية.

وخلال الفترة المسائية ليوم الخميس ألقى الشيخ الددو محاضرة عند تمام الساعة الرابعة مساء بفندق الودان بطرابلس تحدث فيها عن التحديات التي تواجه نهضة الأمة.

وفي سياق متصل ألقى فضيلة الشيخ خطبة الجمعة في "مسجد مراد أغا - بتاجورا" وأكد خلالهاعلى أهمية الوحدة والاتفاق بين كافة مكونات الشعب الليبي من أجل المساهمة الفاعلة في بناء ليبيا ، ومن ثمة وضع لبنة في صرح الأمة الإسلامية العظيم .

لمشاهدة نشاطات الشيخ اضغــــــــــــــــــــــــــــــــــــــــط هنا:
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, made in the course of the past week an extended visit to the sister state of Libya. The visit took in some of the Islamic centres in Libya, as well as meetings with some senior officials and the Friday prayer at the Murad Agha Mosque in Tajoura.

The Sheikh was received by His Eminence the Mufti, Shaykh al-Sadiq bin Abd al-Rahman al-Ghariani, in his office at the House of Fatwa (Dār al-Iftāʾ) in Tripoli on the morning of Thursday (7 March 2013), in a cordial meeting in which the two reviewed the most important current developments in the region and the means of cooperation for the sake of raising up the condition of the community.

In a meeting that brought him together with the governor of the Central Bank of Libya, 'al-Sadiq al-Kabir', on Thursday morning (7 March) at the headquarters of the Central Bank of Libya in Tripoli, the member of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, Shaykh 'Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew', affirmed the necessity of quickening the pace towards achieving Libyan economic stability and of managing its momentum, because it is — as he described it — a priority that contributes to the stability of the country generally, through cooperation between the institutions of the state and its ministries.

The meeting was an occasion on which the Sheikh discussed with the officials of the Central Bank the Islamic banking project launched in the recent period, where the erudite scholar Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew affirmed the soundness of this serious transition and its positive effect on Libyan life and the Libyan economy generally, if it is applied in the right way.

In addition to this, Sheikh al-Dedew made a visit to the Ministry of Endowments (awqāf) in the interim transitional government, in which he met the minister charged with the ministry, the ministry's deputy, and a number of directors and heads of departments within the ministry. The meeting took up the activating of the role of mosques in Libya, particularly in the process of building and of raising awareness that the phase of transition in Libya requires.

Al-Dedew stressed the necessity of maintaining contact with all the intellectual orientations and parties in Libya, and of extensive scholarly dialogue and discussion between the scholars and the students of knowledge, as well as of inviting scholars and jurists from all the Islamic countries and widening the circle of contact with the world and with Islamic ideas and figures.

During the evening period of Thursday, Sheikh al-Dedew delivered a lecture at four o'clock in the afternoon at the Waddan Hotel in Tripoli, in which he spoke of the challenges facing the renaissance of the community.

In a related context, His Eminence the Sheikh delivered the Friday sermon at the 'Murad Agha Mosque – in Tajoura', and affirmed in it the importance of unity and agreement among all the components of the Libyan people, for the sake of an effective contribution to the building of Libya, and thereby the laying of a brick in the great edifice of the Muslim community.

To see the Sheikh's activities, click here:

flags.context: the meeting at the Central Bank of Libya
options: al-Sadiq al-Kabir (a personal name)
the Governor's name as transliterated in Libyan official usage, Sadiq al-Kabir / Saddek Elkaber
flags.note: 'الصديق الكبير' is the personal name of the Governor of the Central Bank of Libya, not a description ('the great friend'). The source's own typographic quotation marks around it show it is being used as a name. A reviewer should settle on the Latin spelling the Bank itself uses before publication.

flags.arabic: مشروع الصيرفة الإسلامية الذي أطلقه خلال الفترة القريبة الماضية
flags.context: the Central Bank meeting
options: the Islamic banking project launched in the recent period
the Islamic banking project he launched in the recent period
the Islamic banking project it [the Bank] launched in the recent period
flags.note: The pronoun in 'أطلقه' is unattached: grammatically it could be the Bank, the Libyan state or the Sheikh himself. Since Libya's law on Islamic banking was a state measure of 2012–13, the agentless 'launched' is used rather than assigning the act to anyone. Style guide §5: the referent of a pronoun is unclear.

flags.arabic: أكّد … على جدوى هذا التحول الجاد
flags.context: the Sheikh's assessment of the conversion to Islamic banking
options: affirmed the soundness of this serious transition
affirmed the usefulness of this serious transition
affirmed that this serious transition is worthwhile
flags.note: 'جدوى' is a judgement of practical benefit, not a legal ruling. It has deliberately not been rendered with any of the five rulings, since an English reader could otherwise take it as the Sheikh declaring the conversion obligatory or recommended, which the source does not say.

translator_notes: Travel and meetings report. Place names use their established Latin spellings (Tripoli, Tajoura, Waddan Hotel). 'دار الإفتاء' is Libya's state fatwa body; rendered with the Arabic alongside on first occurrence. The source uses typographic quotation marks ”…” around two personal names — a CMS artefact rather than quotation, reproduced as single quotes in the English. Source spacing error 'مركزتكوين' and 'خلالهاعلى' preserved in body_ar. The closing 'click here' link points to the site's Islamic Thought index rather than to a specific item. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.

title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في زيارة لدولة الكويت
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew on a Visit to the State of Kuwait
body_ar:
يقوم الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بزيارة للكويت، وخلال هذه الزيارة ألقى الشيخ محاضرة قيمة ضمن فعاليات جائزة الكويت الدولية لحفظ القرآن الكريم ، وبالتنسيق مع وزارة الأوقاف الكويتية .

المحاضرة التي نقلت مباشرة على "قناة إثراء" الكويتية ، تحدث فيها الشيخ باستفاضة ،

عن المعاني الجليلة التي يزخر بها كتاب الله ، كما تحدث عن المكانة العالية التي يحتلها هذا الكتاب ، الذي هو خلاصة وخاتم الكتب السماوية ..

كما تطرق فضيلة الشيخ للمعاني والفيوضات الربانية ، التي يجنيها المشتغلون بهذا الكتاب ؛ دراسة وتلاوة وتدبرا ؛ كما ذكر الشيخ ؛ أن هذا القرآن يضم بين دفتيه دواء لكل الأمراض المستعصية في هذا العصر ، وأن هذا مجرب علمه من علمه ، وجهله من جهله ، وذكر الشيخ تعامل السلف الصالح من صحابة وتابعين مع هذا القرآن

لأنهم فهموا حقيقته ومكانته ،ضاربا المثل بالخليفة الراشد عمر ابن الخطاب رضي الله عنه الذي كان وقافا عند كتاب الله ، فبهذا القرآن يقول الشيخ : تنال معية الله وتتنزل الرحمات ، وتشفى الأنفس والأبدان ، ذاكرا قصة أسيد بن حضير رضي الله عنه الواردة في الصحيحين وقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم له : (تِلكَ السَّكِينَةُ تَنَزَّلتْ للقُرآنِ) .

وفي سياق متصل نظمت رابطة الجالية الموريتانية في دولة الكويت ندوة تحت عنوان:

"المغتربون والفرص المتاحة" أنعشها كوكبة من العلماء الأجلاء وهم :

الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ، ومحمد عبد الرحمن ولد أحمد الملقب "ولد فتى" ، وفضيلة القارئ الإمام : شيخنا ولد سيد الحاج .
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan bin al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, is making a visit to Kuwait. During this visit the Sheikh delivered a valuable lecture within the proceedings of the Kuwait International Prize for the Memorisation of the Noble Qur'an, in coordination with the Kuwaiti Ministry of Endowments.

The lecture, which was broadcast live on the Kuwaiti channel 'Ithraa', was one in which the Sheikh spoke at length,

about the majestic meanings with which the Book of God abounds. He also spoke of the lofty standing this Book occupies, being the summation and the seal of the revealed Books…

His Eminence the Sheikh also touched on the meanings and the divine outpourings gathered by those who occupy themselves with this Book — in study, in recitation and in reflection. The Sheikh mentioned that this Qur'an holds between its two covers a remedy for every intractable disease of this age, and that this has been tested: whoever has known it has known it, and whoever has been ignorant of it has been ignorant of it. The Sheikh mentioned how the righteous forebears, among the Companions and the generation that followed them, dealt with this Qur'an

because they understood its reality and its standing — citing as an example the rightly-guided caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab (may God be pleased with him), who would halt at the Book of God. By this Qur'an, the Sheikh says, God's companionship is attained, mercies descend, and souls and bodies are healed. He mentioned the story of Usayd ibn Hudayr (may God be pleased with him) that appears in the two Ṣaḥīḥ collections, and the saying of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) to him: 'That was the tranquillity (sakīnah) that descended for the Qur'an.'

In a related context, the Association of the Mauritanian Community in the State of Kuwait organised a symposium under the title:

'Expatriates and the Opportunities Available', enlivened by a company of distinguished scholars, namely:

Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew; Muhammad Abd al-Rahman Ould Ahmad, known as 'Ould Fata'; and His Eminence the reciter and imam Shaykhna Ould Sidi al-Hajj.

flags.context: the report of Usayd ibn Hudayr, attributed by the reporter to the two Ṣaḥīḥ collections
options: That was the tranquillity (sakīnah) that descended for the Qur'an
That was the divine presence that came down for the Qur'an
That was the sakīnah, which descended on account of the Qur'an
flags.note: السكينة is a Qur'anic term (e.g. Sūrat al-Fatḥ 48:4) with no single English equivalent; 'tranquillity' is the usual rendering but loses the sense of a descending divine presence. 'للقرآن' may be causal ('on account of') or purposive ('for'). The attribution to al-Bukhari and Muslim is the reporter's and is preserved exactly as given, with no grading added (style guide §4).

flags.arabic: وأن هذا مجرب علمه من علمه ، وجهله من جهله
flags.context: the Sheikh on the Qur'an as a remedy
options: this has been tested: whoever has known it has known it, and whoever has been ignorant of it has been ignorant of it
this is proven by experience — known to those who know it and unknown to those who do not
flags.note: An Arabic rhetorical formula that does not carry over. The literal rendering is kept so that nothing is added; option 1 reads better but smooths an assertion the Sheikh made in a deliberately terse form.

flags.context: the example of the caliph Umar
options: who would halt at the Book of God
who would stop short at the limits of the Book of God
who held fast to the Book of God
flags.note: 'وقّاف عند كتاب الله' is an established idiom for one who stops wherever Scripture sets a limit and goes no further. The literal 'halt at' preserves the image; a reviewer may prefer option 1, which is clearer but adds words the Arabic does not have.

translator_notes: News report of a lecture. The lecture itself is not on this page. 'وزارة الأوقاف الكويتية' is Kuwait's Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs; rendered as 'Ministry of Endowments' to match the glossary for waqf. Mauritanian personal names kept in their Mauritanian forms (Ould). The source's paragraph breaks fall mid-sentence in two places and have been kept where they fall. title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن يحاضر في موسم الأخوة
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Lectures at the Brotherhood Season
body_ar:
ألقى رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو محاضرة في موسم الأخوة الذي تنظمه جمعية "يدا بيد"،موضوع المحاضرة كان تحت عنوان "التنوع العرقي" وقد بين الشيخ أن الحياة مسرح للصراع بين الحق الباطل وأن حكمة الله سبحانه اقتضت أن تقوم هذه الحياة على التنوع والتفاوت بين الناس ، ولكن هذا التفا وت مؤقت في الحياة الدنيا .

وقد استعرض الشيخ النصوص التي حثت على بناء عرى الأخوة والمحبة بين المسلمين وحذرت بشكل صريح من كل أشكال التقاطع والتنافر سد ا لأي فجوة أوثغرة يدخل منها الشيطان لإثارة الفتن والخلاف بين المؤمنين .

وذكر الشيخ بالإجراءات التي اتخذها الشرع لسلامة المجتمع المسلم من الأخطار والفتن حيث حرم الغيبة والشحناء والظلم واللمز والتنا بز بالألقاب والسخرية سعيا لبقاء الألفة والمحبة بين المسلمين وقطعا للطريق أمام كل دواعي الفتنة والقطيعة. وهذه التوجيهات السا مية هي التي حوتها سورة الحجرات حيث كانت دستورا قام عليه المجتمع المسلم في المدينة المنورة.

وأكد الشيخ على أن هذه الأخوة هي التي اعتمدها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في إقامة الدولة في المدينة حيث بنى المسجد وبعده آخى بين المسلمين حتى كانوا يتوارثون على أساس هذه الأخوة قبل نسخها .

وقد عقب على محاضرة الشيخ محمد الحسن فضيلة الشيخ القاضي بال محمد البشير مؤكدا أن مآل الناس إلى طريقين اثنتين لا ثالث لهما: طريق المتقين وطريق المجرمين والإنسان هو الذي يحددطريقه "إما إلى جنة وإما إلى نار".

للمتابعة اضغط هنا..
body_en:
The president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, delivered a lecture at the Brotherhood Season organised by the 'Hand in Hand' Association. The subject of the lecture was under the title 'Ethnic Diversity'. The Sheikh made clear that life is a stage for the struggle between truth and falsehood, and that the wisdom (ḥikmah) of God, glorified be He, has determined that this life should rest upon diversity and disparity between people — but that this disparity is temporary, belonging to the life of this world.

The Sheikh reviewed the texts that urge the building of the bonds of brotherhood and love between Muslims, and that warn in explicit terms against every form of severance and mutual aversion, so as to close off any gap or breach through which Satan might enter to stir up discord (fitnah) and disagreement among the believers.

The Sheikh recalled the measures that the Sharia has taken for the safety of Muslim society from dangers and discord, in that it has forbidden (ḥarām) backbiting, rancour, injustice, disparagement, the trading of insulting nicknames, and mockery — seeking thereby to preserve familiarity and love between Muslims and to block the way before every occasion of discord and rupture. These lofty directives are what Sūrat al-Ḥujurāt contains, where they were a constitution upon which the Muslim society in Medina the Illuminated was founded.

The Sheikh affirmed that this brotherhood is what the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) relied upon in establishing the state in Medina, in that he built the mosque and after it made a bond of brotherhood between the Muslims — so much so that they used to inherit from one another on the basis of this brotherhood, before it was abrogated (mansūkh).

His Eminence Shaykh al-Qadi Bâ Muhammad al-Bashir commented on Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan's lecture, affirming that people end upon two paths and no third: the path of the God-conscious and the path of the criminals, and that it is the human being who determines his own path — 'either to a garden or to a fire'.

To follow it, click here…

flags.context: وقد بين الشيخ أن الحياة مسرح للصراع بين الحق الباطل
options: the struggle between truth and falsehood (reading a dropped و)
leave the phrase as it stands
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). The conjunction is missing: 'الحق الباطل' should read 'الحق والباطل'. As it stands the Arabic would read 'the false truth', which is plainly not the sense. Translated by the evident sense and flagged; body_ar preserves the source.

flags.arabic: حيث حرم الغيبة والشحناء والظلم واللمز والتنابز بالألقاب والسخرية
flags.context: the measures the Sharia has taken
options: it has forbidden (ḥarām) backbiting, rancour, injustice, disparagement, the trading of insulting nicknames, and mockery
it has prohibited backbiting and the rest
flags.note: حرّم is rendered on the fixed mapping as forbidden (ḥarām). Note that the items listed are the prohibitions of Sūrat al-Ḥujurāt 49:11–12, which the paragraph then names. 'الشحناء' is rancour or mutual hatred rather than a named act; a reviewer may wish to check whether the Sheikh listed it among the forbidden acts or as their consequence, since the reporter's sentence does not distinguish.

flags.context: حتى كانوا يتوارثون على أساس هذه الأخوة قبل نسخها
options: before it was abrogated (mansūkh)
before that ruling was abrogated
flags.note: What was abrogated is the inheritance between the emigrants and the helpers on the basis of the bond of brotherhood, not the brotherhood itself; the Arabic pronoun in 'نسخها' is ambiguous between the two. Rendered with the ambiguity preserved. A careless English reading would have the Prophet's bond of brotherhood itself abrogated, which the Sheikh certainly did not say.

flags.context: the commentator Shaykh al-Qadi Bâ Muhammad al-Bashir
options: either to a garden or to a fire
either to Paradise or to the Fire
flags.note: The words are the commentator's, not the Sheikh's, and the source marks them as a quotation without a source. 'Paradise' and 'the Fire' are the established English, and are recommended here; the indefinite Arabic has been kept literally in the body so that nothing is read into a second-hand quotation.

translator_notes: News summary of a lecture on ethnic diversity. Note that everything after the fourth paragraph is a second speaker, and the site must not present it as the Sheikh's. Source defects preserved in body_ar: the dropped conjunction in 'الحق الباطل'; stray spaces inside words ('التفا وت', 'سد ا', 'التنا بز', 'السا مية'); missing spaces at '،موضوع' and 'يحددطريقه'.
